I'm going to abstain because I really dislike the way it's written.
The Grey Wardens are obviously very deserving, however.

I think the way its written is neat but I also think c/c should make a good argument on their own and I dont think this quite meets that bar... mainly cuz of tje way its written. But I'd have to give it a better read through
Don't think they should've gone for this audacious style if the substance was going to be this lacking. Just write a classic commendation -- no one will blame you for it.
i actually like the way it's written, it's unique and fits TGW
but i agree that content wise it could be better
A slug in the desert at noon is pretty unique, too. Doesn't make it any more graceful, though; it's still a slug.
With the respect I have for Aramantha, this resolution is a bit of an eccentricity.
